Unused functions of a loaded module are not compiled, unless running
their def has an effect: a default value is evaluated when the def runs.
-- main.star --
load("lib.star", "used")
print(used())
-- lib.star --
def used():
    return helper() + 1
def helper():
    return 41
def unused_plain(x, y = 2, z = None):
    return x + y
def unused_effect(x = print("default evaluated")):
    return x
